title: Salesforce Docs Portal
clean_text:
### Salesforce Docs Portal

Official Salesforce documentation in formats designed for agents, LLMs, and direct HTTP retrieval.
Admin : Salesforce administrator and end-user help across Salesforce products.
Architect : Salesforce architecture guidance for designing secure, reliable, and integrated solutions.
Developer : Salesforce APIs, programming guides, SDKs, and reference documentation.
Legacy Developer : Legacy Atlas-format Salesforce developer reference that is migrating to the Developer collection.
MuleSoft : MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, connectors, DataWeave, runtime, and related tools.
Tableau : Tableau Desktop, Server, Cloud, Prep, Public, APIs, and Blueprint documentation.
